# Cooking Class Arezzo

> Hands-on Tuscan cooking classes in Arezzo, Italy: fresh handmade pasta and authentic tiramisù, taught by an expert chef in small groups, with unlimited local wines and a full meal of everything participants prepare.

## Key facts

- **What**: Hands-on cooking class — fresh handmade pasta + authentic Italian tiramisù
- **Where**: Arezzo (AR), Tuscany, Italy (exact address shared upon booking confirmation) — walking distance from Arezzo train station, plenty of parking nearby. About 30 minutes from Cortona, ~1 hour from Florence, Siena and Perugia.
- **When**: Tuesday to Friday and Sundays (prior booking required). Time slots: 10:30, 13:00, 17:30.
- **Prices**:
  - Morning class (10:30): €69 per person
  - Lunch class (13:00): €79 per person
  - Afternoon class (17:30): €89 per person
- **Included**: hands-on cooking class; all ingredients and equipment; unlimited local wines; detailed recipes to take home; full meal with what you have prepared.
- **Group size**: small classes for personalized attention, guided by an expert chef.
- **Languages**: English and Italian.
- **Dietary needs**: vegetarian and other requirements accommodated on request.
- **Suitable for**: beginners, couples, families, groups of friends, solo travelers.

## Presented by

The cooking class takes place in Arezzo and is presented and promoted by Il Poggiolino d'Oro Apartment (https://www.ilpoggiolinodoro.it), which also handles bookings.

## Reviews

Rated 5 stars by international guests from the USA, UK, Australia, Germany, Spain, the Netherlands, Switzerland, Denmark, Austria and more. Guests consistently highlight the friendly hosts, clear instruction, excellent house wine and the joy of eating what they made.

## Make it a Tuscan getaway
- **Where to stay**: Il Poggiolino d'Oro (https://www.ilpoggiolinodoro.it) — panoramic holiday home in the Tuscan countryside, 10 minutes from Arezzo. Original wooden beams, valley views, sleeps up to 6. The recommended base for the cooking class.
- **Christmas season**: from mid-November to 6 January Arezzo hosts "Città del Natale", Tuscany's biggest Christmas market, with a Tyrolean village in Piazza Grande. During market weekends, accommodation in the town centre regularly sells out; Il Poggiolino d'Oro (10 minutes away, free parking) is the recommended base. Popular plan: markets in the morning, cooking class at 13:00 or 17:30, night at Il Poggiolino d'Oro.
- **Culture**: Ponte Buriano, the Roman bridge many scholars recognise in the background of Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa, is minutes from Arezzo. Piero della Francesca's frescoes are in town; Cortona, Siena and the Val d'Orcia are easy day trips.
- **Value**: most cooking classes in Tuscany cost €100–200 per person; this class starts at €69.
